translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Miti Wane Ŋetne Mama Eŋane Donv
Mane eŋe miti wane ŋetne mama geakane rayake, eŋe urata lewine suainane similekamaike yale raikene, don iwa welekatne.

Pakiso, miti wane ŋetne mama eŋe sot midaine koboboine ŋanomine weku eŋeropka geake, so kotinane sawe geake, okangi bori worine midaine mayakatne geake, ŋei kuneŋine mat maneo ŋine sariu kima ebuyake, so kito ebo ebon urata mauluke mayake,
eŋe doku togole ne qelaŋ qe gege mane misuk nekei, eŋe sot osi osirop mida, wet pesek so peamine geake, eŋe wesi aboŋ wane bailalaŋ misuk okaniake.
Eŋe eŋine sotawekoune me ŋerep medepine mauluke wareoniake, so eŋe raki gipon borasokoune ewine kito more aŋaine tewekkei.
Mane eŋe eŋine sotawekoune so ŋerep medepine mauluke mi ware oniakeŋo Anutu wane doku tau tau magu daleo magak okan oniake?
So doku musele tau taune ŋei mane eŋe miti wane ŋetne mama misuk geake, sogino Satanŋo Anutu wawaine okan kaki, osopkaki ketke, wane ŋei yaline eŋe wawaine okangi, Anutuŋo yalewaka osopkaki kesiake.
Ŋei mane eŋe eŋetine koboboine ŋei ŋerep doku tau tau maguo mi takotkeki, eŋano payakeŋo ŋetne mamaine geake paki, eŋe qaisikkau Satan wane subaŋo mi kitoyake.
Doku Tau Taune Eŋane Qesi Qesiŋ Eŋane Don

Doku tautau eŋane qesi qesiŋ ŋei, eŋe yalewaka wetene koboboine, wet me belakam etkeka misuk gekei, me doku togole ne qelaŋ qe gege ea mane misuk nekei, me ŋei natne eŋane wesi aboŋ wane bailalaŋ misuk okanikei.
Eŋe wetene koboboine qelaŋanerop paki, Anutu wane mali malip don sogine sanka pake, so wele mo sikan ŋonge, yewa malip kakei.
Ŋine mikepka urataenane liwek ongei, liwekone onbi urata maineka makeiwo, yemo eŋe maine doku tau tau magu eŋane urata ŋei okane gekei.
So ŋanowekopene eŋe yalewaka wetene weku paki, yeye kine kine wet maepko okangei, don ŋade ŋade misuk rakei, sawe ge more koboboine gekei.
Doku tau tau magu eŋane qesi qesiŋ ŋei, eŋe ŋanomine weku eŋerop wet peseko ge more, ŋanom dokoine ma suluke wareongi, aŋa tewe tewek korop gekei.
Ŋeiwa doku tau tau magu eŋane qesi qesiŋ ŋei ge more, urata mauluke ma okanmami, eŋe eŋetene weku mane wakonge, eŋe maine eweke more mali malipene Yesu Kristo wano ra qelaŋangei.
Na mo welekatne geŋano ikopka umore ganikalane okane more, kibi iwa qe ginmaile.

Na esatka mi u lotkekaleo, yemo ge kibi yewaŋo Anutu wane mat urumgo koboboine gege wane golasiake, Anutu gege togon wane mat urum yemo ŋei ŋerep magukoune, eŋe bosiŋ togogole ŋo mat umatne teweke okoramaike, yalewa Anutu wane don wele teweke okorakei.
Anutu wane don sanka pake, ea ra qelaŋan okanmaine, yewamo oŋa qae qaeinerop, ŋei maneŋo don yewa maine mi bisopkeake,

content.text: eŋe ŋei yale didiwo wakonge, Asuŋo kineine ma wakonge yewamo koboine, so Aŋelo edo kakoi, don kisiineŋo ŋei ŋerep korop eŋano arike, kepe baŋem ŋei ŋerep eŋe detluk kakoi, Anutuŋo eŋine qelaŋan koto qeliwo mawake.
